value.name: Putative copy-number alterations from GISTIC
value.description: Putative copy-number calls on 1080 cases determined using GISTIC 2.0. Values: -2 = homozygous deletion; -1 = hemizygous deletion; 0 = neutral / no change; 1 = gain; 2 = high level amplification.

value.name: Methylation (HM450)
value.description: Methylation (HM450) beta-values for genes in 885 cases. For genes with multiple methylation probes, the probe most anti-correlated with expression.
